text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait to prosecute 1,500 stateless people for allegedly hiding their original nationalities and demanding Kuwaiti citizenship. Some 100,000 stateless people, mainly Arabs, reside in Kuwait.
- Gulf Arab industry and commerce ministers to open talks in Riyadh on Sunday.
- Chamber of Commerce and Industry to form joint committees to review problems of commercial and industrial unions.
- Health insurance to be imposed on foreigners residing in Kuwait by July 1998.
- Ministry of Social Affairs and Labour proposes harsher penalties on delinquent juveniles.
- Board members of Chamber of Commerce say foreign investors should be allowed to own majority stakes in local firms.
